An '''assault fleet''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet admiral]]. It was comprised of two [[transport force]]s, two [[force escort]]s, a [[force technical services]], and a [[force support]], for an average of 376 [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Assault fleets were designed to adhere to the "1/4/16/64 Plan," which was the notion of being able to conduct multiple mission profiles with the resources at hand. The plan advocated that an assault fleet should be able to carry out one [[Corps/Legends|corps]]-level operation, four [[Battle group|battlegroup]]-level operations, sixteen [[Regiment/Legends|regimental]]-level operations, and sixty-four [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]-level missions.

==History==
[[Assault Fleet EM4]] was one of several to play a role during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
